page.layout: One column of names, in a ruled box, with the years 1333 to 1340 printed beside the column's groups in the left margin; one marginal note at right beside the 1338 group; below the column, the signature "T 5" and the catchword "Ioan-"; running head at top, page number at top right.
page.notes: The years 1333–1340 are in the left margin, each beside its group of four names; I have placed each year on the first line of its group. The mark after "Folkarding" in 1334 is a small stroke that may be a reference mark or a printing flaw; I could not read it with certainty. "Albertus" in 1336 and "Folkarding" in 1335 and 1339 are printed with some uneven letterforms; the readings are as they appear on the scan. The printed "Ioan-" at the foot is a catchword, cut off by the page end.
